newsitem.title: UK: Standard Chartered director to leave group.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered director to leave group.

text.p: Standard Chartered Plc said on Friday that group executive director John McFarlane will be leaving the banking group in April.
McFarlane is responsible for Standard's activities in Africa, the Middle East, South Asia, UK and the Americas.

"Following the successful repositioning of the group, John now feels that he can make a more strategic contribution elsewhere and it has been agreed that his current role is unlikely to provide him with sufficient scope and challenge," said Standard chairman Patrick Gillam.
